# North Carolina Criminal Law Blog

> A comprehensive resource for North Carolina criminal law updates, case summaries, and legal guidance maintained by the UNC School of Government.

This blog provides timely analysis of criminal law developments in North Carolina, including appellate case summaries, legislative updates, and procedural guidance for legal practitioners. It is maintained by the School of Government at the University of North Carolina and covers federal and state criminal law issues affecting North Carolina.

## Key Topics

- Criminal Law
- North Carolina
- Case Summaries
- Criminal Procedure
- Pretrial Release
- Sex Offender Registration
- Trial Procedure
- First Amendment
- Indictment Procedure
- Sentencing
- North Carolina Court of Appeals
- Fourth Circuit Court of Appeals
- Iryna's Law (HB 307)
- Jeff Welty
- School of Government

## Getting Started

- [North Carolina Criminal Law Blog](https://nccriminallaw.sog.unc.edu): Homepage for NC Criminal Law Blog covering case summaries and legal updates
- [About this Blog](https://nccriminallaw.sog.unc.edu/about-this-blog): About page describing the blog's purpose, guidelines, and contact information

## Case Summaries & Analysis

- [Case Summaries: Fourth Circuit Court of Appeals (February 2026)](https://nccriminallaw.sog.unc.edu/2026/03/17/case-summaries-fourth-circuit-court-of-appeals-february-2026): Case summaries from Fourth Circuit Court of Appeals on qualified immunity
- [Case Summaries: N.C. Court of Appeals (Mar. 4, 2026)](https://nccriminallaw.sog.unc.edu/2026/03/09/case-summaries-n-c-court-of-appeals-mar-4-2026): Case summaries from NC Court of Appeals on drug trafficking and self-defense

## Legislative Updates & Bulletins

- [New Bulletin on Iryna's Law, Plus Additional Resources](https://nccriminallaw.sog.unc.edu/2026/03/16/new-bulletin-on-irynas-law-plus-additional-resources): Bulletin and resources on Iryna's Law (HB 307) pretrial release provisions

## Procedural Guides & Reference Materials

- [Revised Sex Offender Flow Chart (March 2026 Edition)](https://nccriminallaw.sog.unc.edu/2026/03/12/revised-sex-offender-flow-chart-march-2026-edition): Updated flowchart for NC sex offender registration requirements and procedures
- [How Should a Trial Court Respond to a Note from the Jury?](https://nccriminallaw.sog.unc.edu/2026/03/05/how-should-a-trial-court-respond-to-a-note-from-the-jury): Guide on trial court procedures for responding to jury communications
- [Contempt Authority and Procedure for Magistrates](https://nccriminallaw.sog.unc.edu/2026/03/04/contempt-authority-and-procedure-for-magistrates): Reference on magistrate contempt authority under NC General Statutes

## In-Depth Legal Analysis

- [Criminalizing Offensive Speech: The Fighting Words Exception](https://nccriminallaw.sog.unc.edu/2026/03/11/criminalizing-offensive-speech-the-fighting-words-exception-to-the-first-amendment): Analysis of First Amendment fighting words exception and offensive speech law
- [Does Indictment Error Now Require a Showing of Prejudice?](https://nccriminallaw.sog.unc.edu/2026/03/10/does-indictment-error-now-require-a-showing-of-prejudice): Article on NC indictment error standards and prejudice requirements
